## New Skill Submission

**Skill name:** `<!-- e.g. my-awesome-skill -->`

**What does it do?**
<!-- Brief description -->

**Checklist:**

- [ ] Skill directory: `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`
- [ ] Has `name`, `description`, and `triggers` in frontmatter
- [ ] `name` is unique (doesn't conflict with existing skills)
- [ ] Triggers are specific (not overly generic)
- [ ] `tools` lists only the tools actually used
- [ ] Instructions are step-by-step and actionable
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or personal data
- [ ] Tested locally with Ghost
